name: Affordable and Fast Migration
summary: Case study of Evil Martians' nine-day Gatsby-to-Astro migration that kept existing React components intact.
description: A case study of Evil Martians' migration from Gatsby to Astro: one engineer moved a 1,000+ page site in nine days without rewriting the existing React components, replacing the Gatsby GraphQL layer with Astro content collections. Results include 61% less JavaScript at load, mobile Lighthouse performance rising from 66 to 90, and direct dependencies down from 108 to 86.
